name: attn
description: attn — an omgbase-native prototype of a hyper-low-friction attention app: intents are dated Markdown documents that carry their cues as a `cues:` frontmatter list, the focus is one pointer document (the only thing a switch writes), the Stream is reconstructed from the pointer's revisions, `#focus` a virtual OQX join; every switch one atomic `apply` under CAS, over the MINIMAL tools profile (Lit 3 + signals, MCP over Streamable HTTP through webdevproxy)
